item.text: I’m using the frontend-design skill to give Rotaline a visual identity built around the shift timeline: crisp blue, soft lavender, and a product schedule that makes the handoff tangible. I’ll build the full page in one file, including mobile navigation, billing controls, and expandable FAQs.

item.text: The design will use a pale lavender canvas, navy text, cobalt actions, and mint shift indicators. I’m pairing expressive Bricolage Grotesque headings with quiet DM Sans body text. The schedule and attached handoff note will be the main visual; the remaining sections will stay open and restrained so the page feels like Rotaline, rather than a grid of generic SaaS cards.
